claims.sourceText: rr0.org mirror of Hastings's Warren 1965 material, https://rr0.org/time/2/0/0/6/02/24/Hastings_UfosightingsAtIcbmSites/Warren_1965/ , opened 2026-09-19
claims.text: Personnel at F. E. Warren AFB, including the base commander, telephoned Project Blue Book at Wright-Patterson AFB in the earliest hours of 1 August 1965 to report sightings over the Warren Minuteman missile sites. Lt. Anspaugh fielded and logged the calls between about 0130 and 0440. Named callers are Capt. Snelling of the Air Force command post, Col. Johnson the base commander, Col. Williams commanding the Sioux Army Depot at Sidney, Nebraska, and Capt. Howell. Site designators recorded include E Site, G Flight, Quebec Flight, H-2 and B-4.

claims.sourceText: rr0.org mirror of Hastings's F. E. Warren 1965 material, https://rr0.org/time/2/0/0/6/02/24/Hastings_UfosightingsAtIcbmSites/Warren_1965/ , opened 2026-09-19
claims.text: A Project Blue Book telephone log kept by Lt. Anspaugh records calls between 0130 and 0440 on 1 August 1965 reporting objects over the F. E. Warren missile complex, from Capt. Snelling of the Air Force command post, from the base commander Col. Johnson, from Col. Williams commanding the Sioux Army Depot at Sidney, Nebraska, and from Capt. Howell, referring to sites designated E Site, G Flight, Quebec Flight, H-2 and B-4. The memorandum summarising those calls was first published by Dr J. Allen Hynek, Blue Book's civilian scientific consultant, in 'The UFO Experience: A Scientific Inquiry' in 1972.

The contemporaneous-paper half of that split is real and checkable. It includes the National Military Command Center's Memorandum for Record of 29 October 1975 on the Loring penetration; the 24th NORAD Region Senior Director's Log for 7 to 19 November 1975; the Project Blue Book Minot file of October and November 1968 with seven AF Form 117 witness questionnaires; the Project Blue Book telephone log of 1 August 1965 for F. E. Warren; and the 379th Bombardment Wing historian's file of January 1979. All were opened by this board on 19 September 2026.

claims.text: THE COUNTERWEIGHT, ON THE SAME NODE. His method is not testimony alone, and the documentary half of his output is checkable and largely checks out. This board independently opened and read in full the 341st Strategic Missile Wing histories he relies on, the 24th NORAD Region Senior Director's Log for November 1975 that he republishes, and the F. E. Warren AFB Project Blue Book telephone log of 1 August 1965 first published by J. Allen Hynek in 1972. All three are real, and say what he says they say. The board grades the document half and the interview half of his output differently inside the same node.
